all_numeric_inputs: nonnegative mathematical upper bounds; normal-completion guards separately checked

entry.bound_index_abs_max: Absolute initial per-goal bound-list index maximum
entry.bound_list_length_max: Initial per-goal bound-shape list maximum length
entry.bound_table_bindings: Initial binding visits, counting duplicates; prefix contract separate
entry.checksum_bytes_max: Maximum retained checksum string byte length
entry.dictionary_string_bytes_max: Maximum initial hyp key or reverse-map string bytes
entry.gshape_n: Nonnegative scalar; not inferred from map size
entry.hyp_value_abs_max: Absolute initial string-to-index map value maximum
entry.prover_id_abs_max: Absolute maximum of existing serialized prover IDs
entry.prover_id_bindings: Initial binding visits including duplicate keys and IDs
entry.prover_id_scalar_size: Initial size field; not inferred from binding visits
entry.shape_buffer_capacity: Valid backing capacity, at least one; position and native frame separately joined

prohibited_inferences: captured attempt count is later ending upper bound
hash scalar size is actual binding count
inverse-map fidelity is necessary for current result
source prefix p=2 is a direct native observation
semantic_joins: actual later-entry and every reached save attachment
finite well-formed persistent maps and complete stored list/string payloads
mutable Hashtbl prefix traversal, scalar, hash/equality and key/payload contract
restored identifier path join bytes and arithmetic
source scalar, Format and native representation capacities
filesystem, channel/offset and sufficient physical resources where applicable

serializer.argument_visits: Total transformation argument occurrences per save
serializer.attempt_stat_visits: Upper bound at every save for proofAttempt_table binding visits, including later scheduler growth
serializer.attempt_xml_visits: Upper bound at every save for summed goal proofn_attempts binding visits
serializer.path_component_visits: Total file and proof-script path components per save
serializer.raw_string_bytes_sum: Total bytes across source text output occurrences; restored path joins included
serializer.scalar_format_bytes_max: Joined native scalar-conversion output bound, including floating %g
serializer.theory_visits: Theory traversal occurrences per save, may include skipped empty theories conservatively
